frequency_question: How often does a federal agency completely revoke an accreditor's recognition status rather than renewing, extending, or placing it on compliance probation?
membership_rule: Includes any federally recognized accrediting agency for higher education or professional fields evaluated for renewal or subject to formal departmental review proceedings over the past 30 years. Excludes voluntary relinquishments of recognition.

cases.name: ACICS (Accrediting Council for Independent Colleges and Schools) 2016 review

coverage_note: 5 named; represents the universe of high-profile contested major accreditor recognition reviews in recent decades.
known_gaps: Lower-level advisory committee recommendations that did not result in final departmental revocation orders are excluded.
skeleton: 5 major formal high-stakes compliance or renewal evaluations of professional/national accrediting bodies facing severe Department scrutiny since 1990
multiplier: 2 hits out of 5 comparable major contested review processes
validity_reason: The statutory and regulatory framework for Department of Education recognition of accreditors remains stable across multiple presidential administrations.
